profile_text.body:
X Corp is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bastrop, Texas, United States. Its website, x.com, presents the tagline "X. It's what's happening" and describes X as a platform for breaking news, entertainment, sports, and politics with live commentary. The site offers sign-in by email or username and links to sections including About, Get App, Grok, Help, Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Careers, Ads & Business, Developers, News, US TIDA, and Accessibility.

The only AI-related product named on the site is Grok, which appears as a link. The website does not describe what Grok does.

X Corp has 126 legal exposures in Texas. No individual cases are listed.
